rubrics.rubric: Does the report identify seal kit part numbers from the HAWE DZ25 datasheet for 63mm bore cylinders and note the rod diameter discrepancy?
criterion: The report must reference the HAWE DZ25 seal kit table showing for piston diameter 63mm: rod 36mm uses HC01030 (standard) or HC02030 (low friction), and rod 45mm uses HC01031 (standard) or HC02031 (low friction)
The report must acknowledge that the test cylinder has a 40mm rod which is not a standard HAWE option for the 63mm bore
The report must recommend the closest matching seal kit for the custom 40mm rod configuration

rubrics.rubric: Does the report correctly verify that the cylinder's rated pressure of 250 bar (25 MPa) from HAWE DZ25 specifications aligns with the test pressure range of 16-24 MPa?
criterion: The report must confirm that the HAWE DZ25 datasheet specifies an operating pressure of 250 bar (equivalent to 25 MPa)
The report must note that all test pressures used (16 MPa nominal, 20 MPa maximum operating, 24 MPa proof test) are within the cylinder's rated capacity
The report should confirm that the pressure rating exceeds all test pressures

rubrics.rubric: Does the report identify the pressure cycle anomalies showing WARN status at cycle 16 (17.8 MPa extension pressure, 18.5 L/min flow) and cycle 33 (13.5 MPa extension pressure, 29.5 L/min flow)?
criterion: The report must identify Cycle 16 as WARN status with elevated extension pressure of 17.8 MPa (vs. ~16 MPa nominal) and reduced flow rate of 18.5 L/min
The report must identify Cycle 33 as WARN status with reduced extension pressure of 13.5 MPa and elevated flow rate of 29.5 L/min
The report must note that these anomalies indicate intermittent seal performance issues

rubrics.rubric: Does the report identify the REVIEW status anomaly at cycle 24 showing elevated retraction pressure of 12.63 MPa compared to normal range of ~11-11.5 MPa?
criterion: The report must identify cycle 24 as having REVIEW status
The report must state the retraction pressure of 12.63 MPa is approximately 12-14% higher than the normal operating range of 10.8-11.5 MPa
The report must note this indicates potential internal friction or seal binding

rubrics.rubric: Does the report reference rod reconditioning procedures from the Degelman repair guide including the use of emery cloth for smoothing polished surfaces?
criterion: The report must cite the Degelman cylinder repair guide procedure for inspecting polished parts for burrs and scratches
The report must reference the instruction to smooth areas as needed with an emery cloth
The report must identify this as the applicable remediation for the rod roughness issue

rubrics.rubric: Does the report correctly state the operating temperature range compatibility between test specifications (-20 to +80°C) and HAWE DZ25 datasheet parameters (-25 to +70°C for fluid temperature, -30 to +70°C ambient)?
criterion: The report must state the test specification operating temperature is -20 to +80°C
The report must reference the HAWE DZ25 datasheet values: hydraulic fluid temperature -25 to +70°C and ambient temperature -30 to +70°C
The report must note that the +80°C upper limit in test specs slightly exceeds the +70°C fluid temperature rating from the datasheet

rubrics.rubric: Does the executive summary correctly state that field failures correlate with factory test anomalies and identify excessive rod surface roughness as the primary root cause?
criterion: The executive summary must confirm correlation between field failures (premature seal failures at ~38,000 cycles) and factory test anomalies (leakage test failures, dimensional inspection failure, endurance shortfall)
The executive summary must identify the primary root cause as rod surface roughness exceeding specification (Ra 0.28 μm vs. 0.25 μm max)
The executive summary must explain that excessive rod roughness causes accelerated seal wear

rubrics.rubric: Does the corrective action plan include immediate actions to quarantine/inspect current production batch for rod surface roughness before shipment?
criterion: The corrective action plan must recommend quarantine of the current production batch
The corrective action plan must recommend 100% inspection of rod surface roughness using appropriate measurement equipment (profilometer)
The corrective action plan must recommend rejection or reconditioning of any rods exceeding Ra 0.25 μm specification before cylinder assembly

rubrics.rubric: Does the report recommend process modifications to prevent recurrence, such as enhanced in-process surface roughness verification or updated machining parameters?
criterion: The report must recommend implementing in-process surface roughness measurement at rod finishing operations
The report must recommend reviewing and potentially tightening machining parameters (feed rate, cutting speed, tool selection)
The report must recommend establishing statistical process control (SPC) on rod surface finish or adding inspection gates before assembly

rubrics.rubric: Does the report reference locknut torque specifications from the Degelman repair guide applicable for cylinder reassembly?
criterion: The report should reference the piston locknut torque values from the Degelman repair guide torque chart
The report must note these values are needed for proper reassembly after seal replacement
